title: Approval capacity and expertise renewal can become the new constraints
text: The compiler’s critical discussion warns that agents can produce more proposed changes than experts can inspect and that codification can remove learning opportunities for future experts. A sustainable operating model must fund both genuine review and the development of people capable of performing it.
qualification: Explicit editorial interpretation, not a measured claim from the speaker’s internal deployment.
